label: http

properties.name: httpUri
properties.label: common
properties.description: The url of the HTTP endpoint to call.

properties.name: disableStreamCache
properties.label: common
properties.description: Determines whether or not the raw input stream is cached or not. The Camel consumer (camel-servlet, camel-jetty etc.) will by default cache the input stream to support reading it multiple times to ensure it Camel can retrieve all data from the stream. However you can set this option to true when you for example need to access the raw stream, such as streaming it directly to a file or other persistent store. DefaultHttpBinding will copy the request input stream into a stream cache and put it into message body if this option is false to support reading the stream multiple times. If you use Servlet to bridge/proxy an endpoint then consider enabling this option to improve performance, in case you do not need to read the message payload multiple times. The producer (camel-http) will by default cache the response body stream. If setting this option to true, then the producers will not cache the response body stream but use the response stream as-is (the stream can only be read once) as the message body.

properties.name: headerFilterStrategy
properties.label: common,advanced
properties.description: To use a custom HeaderFilterStrategy to filter header to and from Camel message.

properties.name: bridgeEndpoint
properties.label: producer
properties.description: If the option is true, HttpProducer will ignore the Exchange.HTTP_URI header, and use the endpoint's URI for request. You may also set the option throwExceptionOnFailure to be false to let the HttpProducer send all the fault response back.

properties.name: connectionClose
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Specifies whether a Connection Close header must be added to HTTP Request. By default connectionClose is false.

properties.name: httpMethod
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Configure the HTTP method to use. The HttpMethod header cannot override this option if set.

properties.name: logHttpActivity
properties.label: producer
properties.description: To enable logging HTTP request and response. You can use a custom LoggingHttpActivityListener as httpActivityListener to control logging options.

properties.name: multipartUpload
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Whether to force using multipart/form-data for easy file uploads. This is only to be used for uploading the message body as a single entity form-data. For uploading multiple entries then use org.apache.hc.client5.http.entity.mime.MultipartEntityBuilder to build the form.

properties.name: multipartUploadName
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The name of the multipart/form-data when multipartUpload is enabled.

properties.name: skipControlHeaders
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Whether to skip Camel control headers (CamelHttp... headers) to influence this endpoint. Control headers from previous HTTP components can influence how this Camel component behaves such as CamelHttpPath, CamelHttpQuery, etc.

properties.name: skipRequestHeaders
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Whether to skip mapping the Camel headers as HTTP request headers. This is useful when you know that calling the HTTP service should not include any custom headers.

properties.name: skipResponseHeaders
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Whether to skip mapping all the HTTP response headers to Camel headers.

properties.name: throwExceptionOnFailure
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Option to disable throwing the HttpOperationFailedException in case of failed responses from the remote server. This allows you to get all responses regardless of the HTTP status code.

properties.name: clearExpiredCookies
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether to clear expired cookies before sending the HTTP request. This ensures the cookies store does not keep growing by adding new cookies which is newer removed when they are expired. If the component has disabled cookie management then this option is disabled too.

properties.name: contentTypeCharsetEnabled
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the Content-Type header should automatic include charset for string based content.

properties.name: cookieHandler
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Configure a cookie handler to maintain a HTTP session

properties.name: cookieStore
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: To use a custom CookieStore. By default the BasicCookieStore is used which is an in-memory only cookie store. Notice if bridgeEndpoint=true then the cookie store is forced to be a noop cookie store as cookie shouldn't be stored as we are just bridging (eg acting as a proxy). If a cookieHandler is set then the cookie store is also forced to be a noop cookie store as cookie handling is then performed by the cookieHandler.

properties.name: copyHeaders
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: If this option is true then IN exchange headers will be copied to OUT exchange headers according to copy strategy. Setting this to false, allows to only include the headers from the HTTP response (not propagating IN headers).

properties.name: customHostHeader
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: To use custom host header for producer. When not set in query will be ignored. When set will override host header derived from url.

properties.name: deleteWithBody
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the HTTP DELETE should include the message body or not. By default HTTP DELETE do not include any HTTP body. However in some rare cases users may need to be able to include the message body.

properties.name: followRedirects
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether to the HTTP request should follow redirects. By default the HTTP request does not follow redirects

properties.name: getWithBody
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the HTTP GET should include the message body or not. By default HTTP GET do not include any HTTP body. However in some rare cases users may need to be able to include the message body.

properties.name: httpActivityListener
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: To use a custom activity listener

properties.name: ignoreResponseBody
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: If this option is true, The http producer won't read response body and cache the input stream

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: okStatusCodeRange
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: The status codes which are considered a success response. The values are inclusive. Multiple ranges can be defined, separated by comma, e.g. 200-204,209,301-304. Each range must be a single number or from-to with the dash included.

properties.name: preserveHostHeader
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: If the option is true, HttpProducer will set the Host header to the value contained in the current exchange Host header, useful in reverse proxy applications where you want the Host header received by the downstream server to reflect the URL called by the upstream client, this allows applications which use the Host header to generate accurate URL's for a proxied service

properties.name: userAgent
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: To set a custom HTTP User-Agent request header

properties.name: clientBuilder
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Provide access to the http client request parameters used on new RequestConfig instances used by producers or consumers of this endpoint.

properties.name: clientConnectionManager
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use a custom HttpClientConnectionManager to manage connections

properties.name: connectionsPerRoute
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The maximum number of connections per route.

properties.name: httpClient
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Sets a custom HttpClient to be used by the producer

properties.name: httpClientConfigurer
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Register a custom configuration strategy for new HttpClient instances created by producers or consumers such as to configure authentication mechanisms etc.

properties.name: httpClientOptions
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To configure the HttpClient using the key/values from the Map. This is a multi-value option with prefix: httpClient.

properties.name: httpConnectionOptions
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To configure the connection and the socket using the key/values from the Map. This is a multi-value option with prefix: httpConnection.

properties.name: httpContext
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use a custom HttpContext instance

properties.name: maxTotalConnections
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The maximum number of connections.

properties.name: useSystemProperties
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use System Properties as fallback for configuration for configuring HTTP Client

properties.name: nonProxyHosts
properties.label: producer,proxy
properties.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that should bypass the proxy. Supports wildcards, e.g., localhost,.example.com,192.168..

properties.name: hostnameVerificationPolicy
properties.label: security
properties.description: Controls how hostname verification is performed during the TLS handshake. CLIENT (default) delegates entirely to the configured x509HostnameVerifier, preserving the behaviour of httpclient 5.5 and earlier a NoopHostnameVerifier will disable verification. BUILTIN uses the JDK SSLParameters hostname check only, ignoring the configured verifier. BOTH runs the JDK built-in check first and then the configured verifier; a NoopHostnameVerifier cannot bypass the built-in check under BUILTIN or BOTH. Prefer BOTH when no custom verifier semantics are needed for stronger out-of-the-box security.

properties.name: oauth2BodyAuthentication
properties.label: producer,security
properties.description: Whether to use OAuth2 body authentication.

properties.name: oauth2CachedTokensDefaultExpirySeconds
properties.displayName: Oauth2 Cached Tokens Default Expiry Seconds
properties.label: producer,security
properties.description: Default expiration time for cached OAuth2 tokens, in seconds. Used if token response does not contain 'expires_in' field.

properties.name: oauth2CachedTokensExpirationMarginSeconds
properties.displayName: Oauth2 Cached Tokens Expiration Margin Seconds
properties.label: producer,security
properties.description: Amount of time which is deducted from OAuth2 tokens expiry time to compensate for the time it takes OAuth2 Token Endpoint to send the token over http, in seconds. Set this parameter to high value if you OAuth2 Token Endpoint answers slowly or you tokens expire quickly. If you set this parameter to too small value, you can get 4xx http errors because camel will think that the received token is still valid, while in reality the token is expired for the Authentication server.

properties.name: oauth2CacheTokens
properties.label: producer,security
properties.description: Whether to cache OAuth2 client tokens.

properties.description: OAuth2 client secret

properties.name: oauth2ResourceIndicator
properties.label: producer,security
properties.description: OAuth2 Token endpoint

properties.name: oauth2Scope
properties.label: producer,security
properties.description: OAuth2 scope

properties.name: oauth2TokenEndpoint
properties.label: producer,security
properties.description: OAuth2 Resource Indicator

properties.name: sslContextParameters
properties.label: security
properties.description: To configure security using SSLContextParameters. Important: Only one instance of org.apache.camel.util.jsse.SSLContextParameters is supported per HttpComponent. If you need to use 2 or more different instances, you need to define a new HttpComponent per instance you need.

properties.name: x509HostnameVerifier
